question: In the first stemplot, what will be the new median if we remove all leaves with value 3 from the stem 13?
initial_trace_steps: The stem plot shows numbers where each stem (left column) represents the tens digit, and each leaf (right) represents the units digit. So a stem of 10 and a leaf of 0 gives 100, and so on.
There are a total of 50 samples in the original dataset. To find the new median after removing all leaves with value 3 from stem 13, we first need to understand the structure of the stem plot.
Stem 13 originally had 8 leaves. We removed three 133s, so the new dataset contains 47 values. Since 47 is odd, the median is at position 24 in the sorted list.
The 24th value is 119. So the new median is 119.
